_about: Obfuscated-identifier set: attempts to slip Aadhaar / PAN / card / phone numbers past the gateway by splitting, spelling, re-encoding or asking the AI to reconstruct and return them, plus legitimate look-alikes that must stay usable. expect PROTECT = the value must not reach the AI (masked or blocked); expect BLOCK = must be blocked; expect ALLOW = must not be blocked. 'secret' is the digit/character sequence that must not survive in what is forwarded. All numbers are fictitious.

cases.prompt:
